nodes.text: 人工呼吸器 決策指南 Ventilator Decision Aid
什麽是人工呼吸器？ What is a ventilator?
當病人連上人工呼吸器時會發生什麼情況？如何操作？ What happens when someone is attached to a ventilator? How is it done?
什麼時候須要人工呼吸器？ When do people need a ventilator?
誰應該使用這份指南？ Who should use this guide?
人工呼吸器可能有何帮助？How might using a ventilator help?
人工呼吸器可能造成哪些傷害？How might a ventilator cause harm?
人工呼吸器能使病情好转嗎？Does a ventilator help people to get better?
人工呼吸器對哪些病人最有益？Who is most likely to be helped from being on a ventilator?
人工呼吸器對哪些病人較無益？Who is less likely to be helped by using a ventilator?
使用人工呼吸器，會是什麼樣的情況？ What is it like being on a ventilator?
一旦用了人工呼吸器，他們可以停止不用嗎？ Once someone is on a ventilator, can they come off?
如果有人需要長時間使用人工呼吸器，會有什麼情況出現呢？ What happens if someone needs a ventilator for a long time?
對決定不嘗試人工呼吸器的病人，會有什麼情況？ What happens to people who decide NOT to try a ventilator?
人們如何決定是否要試用人工呼吸器？ How do people decide whether or not to try a ventilator?
